item.title: 20-30 minute meditations
item.description: These are guided meditation recordings that have been played at RC’s Monday Meditation. Monday Meditation greatest hits Thich Nhat Hanh: Mindfulness of breathing 20 min “Breathing in, I know I am breathing in." "Breathing out, I know I am breathing out.” Can You Zen: Guided Breath Meditation (Anapana) 30 min Vipassana Meditation 30 min Rob Burbea: Practising the Jhānas - Counting Within the Breath 30 min (0:38 - 30:00) Shinzen Young: How to structure your practice in life 28 min (6:40 - 34:30) noting vipassana: feel, hear, see, do nothing Brightmind: Thoughts & Emotions - Feel In Physical Senses - Hear Out … Michael Taft: Do Nothing Meditation, aka “Dropping the Ball” 31 min Tasshin: Guided meditations for love practice various, most are ~30 min mettā and the brahmavihārās Sharon Salzberg: 10-Day Lovingkindness Challenge various, 15 min A few shorter ones Pema Chödrön: Tonglen Meditation 12 min Daniel Ingram: How To Awaken From Emotional Turmoil 6 min A few others S.N.

item.title: T3100e vintage computer
item.description: The Toshiba T3100e is a “luggable” PC-compatible computer introduced in 1988. It has an Intel 80286 CPU, 1 MB RAM, 20 MB hard disk, 3.5” floppy drive, and a stunning 640x400 orange monochrome gas-plasma display.
